description: Election Commission - Declare that J. D. A. Sriyani as a member of the Karandiniya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections classification category.
